why: What a line explains changes on screen (2026-10-22, submarine r2: the lines said the vents open, the tanks fill, the pump pushes water out and the trim levels the boat, and every tank was a still box - no camera can explain what does not happen). A shot list names each change by its kind (direction.change); the build makes it (blender_ops/change_scene.py) and measures that the screen differs between its start and end (studio/change_moves.py). A new kind is a row here, never a branch in code.
rule: makes: how the build makes it - fill (a body inside the part rising or falling to the level, shaped by the part), transform (the part, or the whole subject, turned, moved or scaled about its centre; mode says which: rotate, translate or scale), drive (the part's own spec joint, when it has one; else the transform it falls back to), simulate (a stream from the part). value: what from/to mean and their range. keeps_axis: a scale whose `axis`, when given, keeps its length (a hull squeezed in girth, not in length). color_srgb: what a made stream is drawn in. needs: what a change of this kind must also say (axis: x|y|z of the world, or the object's own length|width|height, to turn about; toward: [x, y, z] to move or flow along). measure: how the screen is judged between the change's start and end - area (the made body's area on screen), travel (the centre's travel), outline (the silhouette's overlap), size (the box's size). screen_min: the least change the screen must show for it to read (a share: of the area, of the frame, of the box, or 1 - overlap).

kinds.means: 수위: 탱크 속 물이 차오르거나 빠진다
열리고 닫힘: 문, 벤트, 밸브가 돈다
눌림·커짐: 크기가 바뀐다 (axis를 주면 그 축의 길이는 그대로 두고 나머지만)
분출: 부품에서 공기나 거품이 뿜어져 나온다 (흰 덩어리 흐름으로: 입자 연기는 화면 측정에 보이지 않는 대기라서)
